text: A knowledge-base skill suite covers retrieval, archival, graph, experience, init/update, Persona skills (butian, soul, soul-rag) and two distillation engines (nuwa-skill, dot-skill); a dispatcher routes without executing. Its flagship QDCVR (Query-Driven, Content-Verified Retrieval) uses six stages: KB selection with diversity balancing; multi-path recall (BM25, vector, tag-semantic, graph); independent 0–8 content verification (<6 expands tags/desc, ≤4 hard-discarded); cross-validation with dedup and rank fusion; P0/P1/P2 confidence tiering with blind-spot declaration; cited synthesis. A 0.95 vector score buys nothing if content ≤4. Credibility: P0 needs vector ≥0.65, content ≥6, rating ≥4, reviews ≥1; P1 ≥0.45/≥4; P2 ≥0.35/≥3. Modifiers: disputed or unvetted cap tiers; short content downgrades to P2. SOUL personas (soul-<name>, four constitutional docs plus soul-config.yml) evolve via 补天 distillation, curiosity training and RL reinforcement. Long jobs are non-blocking, returning task_id. Vector index: one KB → one kb_{kb_id} collection, BGE-M3 1024-dim; ChromaDB fallback returns empty.
